summary: Meta's Threads API for publishing posts, managing replies and reading insights.
access_note: Create a Meta app with the Threads use case; permissions for other users need App Review and the app must be published.
blocker_note: Each permission must be approved via App Review and the app published before other users can connect.

evidence.quote: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol
To access the Threads API, create an app and pick the Threads use case
each permission must first be approved through the App Review process, and your app must be published
The Threads API can be accessed by either graph.threads.com or graph.threads.net
Production-ready Model Context Protocol server for Threads.com API

notes: No official Meta Threads MCP found. REST is inferred from the Graph-style HTTP endpoints on graph.threads.com; no Threads page says REST outright.
